sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Pinus strobus, the eastern white pine, is a tall tree native to eastern North America. It can reach about 46 m.

sections.title: Needles and cones
sections.text: Soft blue-green needles, 6–13 cm long, grow in bundles of five. The hanging cones are about 10–20 cm long and contain winged seeds.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: Its timber has been widely used. The sources consulted describe the seeds as winged but do not establish them as a human food, so no food use is stated here.
